subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: We should always keep in mind (a) —— all kinds of physical exercise are not suitable for all. Different people have different capabilities. (b) ——, harder exercise like wrestling (c) —— gymnastics are suitable for young people (d) —— they have energy to perform them. Weaker and old people should take the milder exercises (e) —— include walking, jogging, free hand exercises etc.
guide_solution: Complete the passage with connectors: (a) that (b) However (c) and (d) because (e) which
